flags.message: Salience-version mismatch: all three candidates (claude-baseline, gemini-baseline, codex-baseline) froze band `baseline` under `salience_version: sal-v3`, but the committed metrics/statpack.md renders its only 'Segment base rate by salience band' table under sal-v4. Per the evaluate contract, segment_base_rate and brier_skill_score are omitted and base_rate_basis is null for every candidate on this cell (no terminal relabel). The pack's JSON still carries sal-v3 rows per Term under `terms[].alt_segments`, so an in-code recompute keyed on the prediction's own version could restore the cert skill score if that is wanted.

Capture observation on codex-baseline's retrieval_log.json: it reports in retrieval.md a CourtListener MCP opinion search (bounded to filings before 2026-02-01, returned HTTP 429), but the log carries no distinct mcp row — only scripted shell batches and one 'other' call whose payload is a harness credential redaction. Not a leakage signal (forward cell, pre-petition bound, nothing returned); noted because the log's fidelity is what the leakage grading rests on.
